subject: Material selection for reliable manufacture
hook: Panel cutting and edging for the trade, made in Hanley.
gbp:
Need panels cut, edged or drilled without tying up your own workshop? SUPERIO offers trade workshop services from our base in Hanley, Stoke-on-Trent, for joiners, kitchen fitters, shopfitters and furniture makers.

Services include panel cutting on a sliding table panel saw, ABS edge banding in 0.4 mm, 1 mm and 2 mm, panel drilling on a multi-spindle boring machine (hinge cups, shelf-pin rows, dowel holes), and cabinet assembly. You can order cut only, cut and edge, drilled panels, or fully assembled cabinets.

To keep jobs moving, send a cutting list with finished sizes, quantities, sheet size, decor code, board thickness, grain direction and the edging you want on each edge. We'll come back with a priced cutting list.

Workshop collection by arrangement; delivery is quoted per job. Trade and domestic orders welcome. Tap Learn more to see our trade services.
